entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: To reiterate, just so we're clear, you[n]will immediately be expelled if you[n]cause any problems.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: In my opinion, you're nothing[n]but a liability, but we had our[n]circumstances to consider...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Whatever you might've gotten away[n]with in your hometown... those days[n]are over.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: If you are thrown out from our school,[n]there will be no place for you to go.[n]Keep that in mind.
entries.uk: Якщо тебе виженуть з нашої школи,[n]тобі не буде куди йти.[n]Пам'ятай про це.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: This is the teacher in charge of your class.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Be sure to read the school rules. Any[n]violations will send you straight to the[n]guidance office.
entries.uk: Обов'язково прочитай шкільні правила.[n]За будь-яке порушення одразу підеш[n]до кабінету виховної роботи.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: And, if by chance you cause any[n]problems, I won't be able to protect[n]you at all.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: He is responsible for all his actions.
entries.uk: Він сам відповідає за всі свої вчинки.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But really though, why me? There[n]should've been better candidates.
entries.uk: Але все ж, чому я? Мали ж бути[n]кращі кандидати.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: It was a sudden transfer, and your class[n]was the only one that had an opening.
entries.uk: Перевід був раптовий, і місце було[n]лише у вашому класі.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If you're done explaining things, mind[n]if we get going?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I got a store to get back to.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Sakura-san, please keep a close eye[n]on him.
entries.uk: Сакура-сан, будь ласка, пильно[n]за ним наглядайте.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Don't let him cause any trouble outside...
entries.uk: Не дозволяйте йому накоїти лиха поза школою...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, I'll be sure to have a serious[n]talk about the situation he's in.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Come to the faculty office when you[n]arrive at school tomorrow. I'll show[n]you to your classroom.
entries.uk: Завтра, коли прийдеш до школи,[n]зайди до вчительської. Я відведу[n]тебе до класу.
